question: Does a 2024 Lin Zhenyue conference report establish a direct research route to new materials concerning Tieqin Tongjian Lou books sold to Beijing Library, and can that title alone select the acquisition route of target catalog nos. 3482/3483?
answer: The report route is real and materially relevant, but the target transaction remains unresolved. A public conference handbook for the 18th Ancient-Book Research Young Colleagues Salon / Tongji University 2nd Young Scholars Workshop on Epigraphy identifies Tongji University Chinese Department as organizer, dates the meeting 2024-10-25 through 2024-10-27 at Yuntong Building, and schedules Lin Zhenyue on 2024-10-26 09:50-10:05 in Yuntong 221 with the exact report title 《铁琴铜剑楼藏书售归北京图书馆新史料》. An official Chinese Academy of Sciences Institute for the History of Natural Sciences researcher profile independently corroborates the same meeting identity/date/place through another participant's activity record. No public abstract, slides, proceedings paper, or report text was recovered. Therefore the existence of a dedicated new-materials research line on the sale-to-Beijing-Library pathway is closed at title/schedule level only. It does not prove which materials were used, whether Gao Xizeng's annotated catalog was among them, whether 3482/3483 were discussed, or whether the target volume was sold rather than donated or transferred by another route.
